what: R16 (contract updated, docs/v2/plan/lanes/db/query-unify.md `View`): after 01217 renumbering, `Storage::view()` can repeat an earlier view's number, and the front end keys caches on `(Nonce, View)` equality as "nothing changed" (hir semantics/source_to_def.rs:306, hir-ty next_solver/interner/tls_cache.rs:160/175/468, method_resolution/pick_cache.rs:134/400, blaze-macro-eval code.rs:89): a repeat makes them serve stale entries. Make the public `View` `View(pub(crate) u64)`, a count of views ever opened kept in Storage (`opened: u64`, +1 in next_view, untouched by renumber), returned by `view()`; `as_u32` becomes `as_u64`; internal row stamps stay u32. Fix db/tests.rs:74 and :1051 (the renumber test should assert the stamp went down via a crate-internal accessor and `view()` went UP, strictly greater than before the renumber). No front-end call site changes (they use ==/Ord only).

history.note: query-unify-engine -> query-unify: engine child idle at 70% context; query-unify writes R17 with R18 (singleton absence) so engine and macros land together
public View is a never-reused u64 count of views opened (storage.rs `opened`), as_u64; renumber test asserts stamp went down and view() went up (db/tests.rs).
